decision_rationale: This is a primary model paper on pre-mRNA sequence modeling, but the candidate model is built on genomic sequences rather than natural-language text. The abstract and full-text excerpts describe embeddings for nucleotides and splicing prediction, with no substantive text component or text-bio bridge.
evidence_snippet: “pre-trained on the precursor messenger RNA sequences of 72 vertebrates” and “generating embeddings that preserve the evolutionary information of nucleotides”
